keywords: The Appellant challenged the trial judge’s judgement and interlocutory decree in a declaration of title action on prescription. Held - seeing no reason to interfere, Appeal dismissed with costs as Appellant failed to prove any overt act to qualify as holder of prescriptive title to land in suit.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
